title: Configuration with an added clock tape
statement: Let $c$ be a configuration with $k$ work tapes over an alphabet $\Gamma$ and state type $S$, on input $x$. Given a state value $q$ (possibly absent), a tape $ct:\mathbb{Z}\to\mathrm{Option}(\Gamma)$, and a head position $cp\in\mathbb{Z}$, the clock configuration has $k+1$ work tapes: it preserves the input-head position, the original tapes and their head positions, and the output of $c$, while appending $ct$ as the additional tape with head position $cp$ and using $q$ as its state.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a $k$-tape configuration with symbol type $\Gamma$ and state type $S$ on input $x$
